title: Heidelberg Castle
visualBrief: Present-day red-sandstone palace ruins around an open court: restored twin-gabled Friedrich wing, roofless Ottheinrich and English wings, broken defensive towers and52m gate.

nativeAxes.origin: Mapped site center; lowest moat foundations Y=0, court Y=12m

identityFeatures: Twin Friedrich gables and slate roof above the northern terrace
Roofless Ottheinrich and English wings with true through-openings
Broken round towers, fallen powder-tower wall and curved-roof gate tower

reconstruction.basis: Official current-site isometry, owner photographs and OSM site boundary
reconstruction.scope: Main castle and immediate defensive terraces; no distant gardens, interiors or terrain mesh

geographicProposal.reviewStatus: Research frame only; actual terrain seating pending
geographicProposal.notes: Signed frame from south gate/north terrace; manually reconstructed wings and12m court datum need hillside/moat terrain review.

scaleBasis: Mapped273.118×214.468m site frame includes garden grounds. Individual wing footprints and heights reconstructed from owner plan/photos; gate52m from moat base, courtyard12m. No extrusion of the entire site boundary. Terrain attachment pending.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.

materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
